html:
Here is an image of M31 taken with the Zenithstar 80 ED APO and the Meade 0.63x focal reducer. The reducer was placed closer to the refractor than normally required. At the prescribed distance of 85 mm, focusing is impossible. However, placed too close to the refractor, the focal reducer produces a lot of distortion at the edge of the image



Here is an enlargement of the upper right corner of the image.
